instruction.text: Turn left from the place you are standing and exit the room, you can find a staircase infront of you, go up the stairs, turn right and move a bit forward, now you are facing towards the fridge, where to the left you can find a sink, slightly turn to your right and move forward, to the left you can find a table, move a bit forward, now you are behind the couch, that would be your end point.
